argument: For r(x)=c+k*tanh(x)-x, stationary points are +/-atanh(sqrt(1-1/k)); their values are c+/-B. The positive interval |c|-B excludes two extra roots. Bounded increasing g implies every plain Picard trajectory converges, hence to this unique root. Interval arithmetic uses 60 decimal digits.
